implementation.note: Real native client fixture verified shortcut label/select, M and mouse/touch Move, text-focus suppression, armed immobile Attack/Stop, passive tooltip and hosted Quit dispatch. Browser controls scene exercised F6/M/F7. Tooltip clipping correction is included in retained native touch/aura captures; mobile OS exit is not established.

architecture.note: Existing GameClient action/card-key path handles shortcut and standard Move mode; standard commands go through existing command dispatch. Passive buttons carry description and stay disabled. Quit delegates to platform requestQuit. No simulation authority or alternative input system added.

native_api.note: Existing GameClient and InputFlow action routing expose shared host controls; platform requestQuit remains application termination owner. Native fixture exercises the actual client/RmlUi path.

skill.note: Existing controls recipe documents selectionShortcut.hotkey, command-card overrides, text focus, immobile subjects/passives and platform Quit boundary.

studio.note: Implemented shared Project settings editor through game_info/set_manifest, exact original-manifest and project fences, raw JSON native parsing, draft retention and existing Project history. TypeScript/native tests and live UI acceptance pending; no feature-specific schema bypass.

graphs.note: This adds ordinary command-card/input configuration and callbacks, not a user-authored graph or graph evaluator.

platforms.note: Mac client acceptance passed. Web demo build with Emscripten 7.0.1 exposed missing cstdlib in shared triangle collision; correcting the explicit dependency before continuing web acceptance.

dependencies.note: Reuses RmlUi, existing InputFlow key bindings and platform termination API; no new package or solver.

headless.note: Local HUD actions emit existing commands; server command semantics are unchanged. There is no server HUD or menu to render.

examples.note: Tracked controls demo exercised in native Metal and real WebGL browser: selection shortcut, Move, tower card, passive ability, explicit Sell cell and Quit menu.

tests.note: Actual hosted GameClient Metal fixture passed shortcut, text-focus suppression/blur, mouse and touch Move, public view.select tower, disabled aura with readable hover description and pause Quit. Evidence records scope. Final merged-tree quick gate pending.

documentation.note: Controls recipe, demo instructions and game-format reference describe authored hotkeys and standard card behavior.

publishing.note: Browser-tested controls demo pinned in site/manifest.json; bilingual devlog prepared with real captures. Main integration and actual site publication pending.
